notes: KNOWN FAILING (documented target, not yet live-recorded). Agent creates three todo items via write_todos and walks each pending→in_progress→completed within a single session — no subagent tool call. The phase DSL below covers the ready→working→ready state arc, pinned same_session_as:session_birth throughout so a reminder-agent child's own arc (muse spawns goal-reminder/verify-reminder children on EVERY prompt, format-spec §9) can never satisfy a phase match instead of the parent's — the exact vacuous-pass mechanism the sibling 2-2 cell hit and fixed. Two things the phase DSL cannot express are expected to currently FAIL and are the reason this cell is known_failing: (1) the session API's tasks field, which should show the three items with matching subjects/status (daemon=bug: todo_snapshot_updated falls into parser.go's default Skip=true arm, so SessionMetrics.Tasks never populates); (2) SubagentCount, which should stay 0 but is expected to be nonzero while muse's own goal-reminder/verify-reminder children are alive (daemon=bug: parentSessionIDFromPath links any <parent>/subagent/<child-id>/ directory regardless of whether it is a genuine Agent-spawned subagent or an internal reminder micro-agent). Neither gap is agent-side: muse's write_todos tool itself spawns no subagent.
